notes.title: YoloX release!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone

Welcome to the YoloX launch! This project was born of inspiration and learnings from many FPS communities and their esports scenes. Years of experience from the YoloMouse project have also contributed in what we hope you find to be a next level crosshair app, and more importantly, a secure and safe one! ;)

While this launch includes some great new features, Some really cool ones are planned very soon!

Feedback greatly appreciated! - community tab - reddit - support@dragonrisegames.com


May you guru in your pew pew! ːsteamhappyː
